title: Life of a company: event driven filings
text:
This guidance is for:

 • directors

 • secretaries

 • people acting as advisers to UK registered companies

 It covers what you need to file when particular changes occur within your company. This means Companies House can update the public record so searchers can access an up-to-date picture of your company.
